title: Septeo IT Solutions tells clients an unauthorised party extracted data from an internal client-management platform
date_note: Date is the detection day given by cyberattaque.org (22 November); the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: France, as the source describes Septeo as a French software publisher; no city stated
summary: Cyberattaque.org reports, from an email to clients that it says it obtained, that Septeo IT Solutions, a subsidiary of French software publisher Septeo, detected unauthorised access to an internal client-management platform on 22 November. The email says customer contact, public company, billing and support-ticket data were extracted and that Septeo's software and services were not affected. The number of companies and the volume of data were not disclosed.
plain: A French software company's subsidiary told clients that someone got into an internal customer-management platform and took customer data. Its software and services were reportedly not affected.
exec: Septeo IT Solutions' client email says customer contact and billing data were extracted; the scope has not been disclosed.
action: Septeo's email warns clients about phishing and fraudulent payment requests and says its bank details have not changed.

validation.note: One publisher (cyberattaque.org) quoting a client email from Septeo IT Solutions; the email itself and any Septeo public statement were not read (the site says it found no public statement as of 25 November). Searches found no second publisher.
